name: Ya zdes ne prosto tak
source:
If you think this is just another simple variation of Semyon ending up in Sovyonok, think again. While the story begins with a bus and an unexpected awakening at the gates of the pioneer camp, things aren't as simple as they might seem.

The protagonist tries to figure out why he ended up there. He is sure that he wasn't just thrown in there for nothing - he definitely has a task. The situation becomes even more confusing with the appearance of the real Ulyana. The protagonist sets himself the goal of helping Ulyana and taking care of all the residents of the camp. He is helped in this by the fact that he already knows everything about this place. But how does he know this, and what kind of danger could threaten the inhabitants of Sovyonok?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=804310759]Steam[/url]]
translation:
如果你认为这只是Semyon的另一个简单变体，最后出现在Sovyonok，请再想一想。虽然故事是从一辆公共汽车和在拓荒者营地门口意外苏醒开始的，但事情并不像看上去那么简单。

主角试图弄清楚他为什么会来到这里。他确信他不是无缘无故地被扔在那里的——他肯定有任务。随着真正的乌里安娜的出现，情况变得更加混乱。主角给自己设定的目标是帮助乌里安娜并照顾营地中的所有居民。他已经了解这个地方的一切，这对他有帮助。但他怎么知道这一点，以及什么样的危险会威胁到索维诺克的居民呢？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=804310759]Steam[/url]]
